mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points over three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3pp in three months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% in three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% over two months signals a contraction in supply, which leads to increased prices and reduced corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 2% in two months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over a month signals strong labor demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals a shift in demand composition towards consumption, which boosts consumer-oriented sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS growth exceeded GDPC1 growth in a quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) for two consecutive months, it signals a real tightening of monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was above CPIAUCSL for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase simultaneously over a month, it signals a tightening labor market with strong job creation, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decrease & PAYEMS increase in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased and PAYEMS increased simultaneously in a month.
